Stop.description: slack-ping-on-stop: sends a Slack message when Claude finishes a task
typefully-draft-queue: queues any content output as a Typefully draft
zapier-webhook: fires a Zapier webhook with the session payload on task completion

SessionEnd.description: notion-session-log: writes a session summary entry to a Notion database
daily-digest-slack: sends a structured summary of the session to a Slack channel
